THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 2_ day of NovEuL, 200, by and between NAOMI KLEIN, an individual, residing at 759 Ocean Parkway, Brooklyn, New York 11230 ("Owner"), and EAST 86 HOLDINGS LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 22 Ball Street, 3?d Floor, Irvington, New Jersey 07111 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 60 of Block 6494 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 759 Ocean Parkway, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land,” the building located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein referred to as the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 1 of Block 6494 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 620 Foster Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Developer Land"); WHEREAS,Developer intends to construct a new building on all or a portion of the Developer Land, (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are sometimes herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"), the Owner Parcel and Developer Parcel are sometimes herein referred to separately as a “Parcel”or collectively as the“Parcels”; WHEREAS, the rear portion of the yard of the Owner Parcel is undeveloped, open and unobstructed from the ground level to the sky (the “Unbuilt Area"), and a portion of this Unbuilt Area shall remain undeveloped, open and unobstructed from the ground level to the sky and shall comprise the “Easement Area"or "Easement”(as here after defined). WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct the Developer Building incorporating the Easement Area into the design of the Developer Building to satisfy certain rear yard requirements as set forth in the applicable provisions of the Zoning Resolution,and the Parties therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution to create a “Merged Zoning Lot”(as hereinafter defined) so as to make the Easement Area 1

1 available for utilization in the design of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Easement Area available to Developer for the purposes described in this Agreement; WHEREAS,Owner andDeveloperhavepreviouslyexecuted aDeclaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions - a/k/a Exhibit IV (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot is herein referred to as the“Merged Zoning Lot,”and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the utilization of the Easement Area to satisfy the applicable rear yard requirements of the Developer Building (this Agreement, the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions. As used herein: (a)“Applicant”’ shall mean the Party who is an applicant for a building or alteration permit or otherwise from the NYC Department of Buildings or such applicable governmental agency having jurisdiction over the Parcels. “Easement Area” shall be the rear 35 feet of the Owner Parcel, as more particularly described on Exhibit "C” annexed hereto. (c) "Owner Development Area” shall mean that portion of the Owner Parcel outside of theEasement Area. (d) “"Violation" shall mean any violation of the Zoning Resolution or any building code, fire code, or other law, ordinance or regulation which would adversely affect the issuance of a temporary or permanent Certificate of Occupancy for any building located on the Merged Zoning Lot or prevent the issuance of a building permit or any other permits or approvals required by law to build on any parcel that is part of the Merged Zoning Lot or create a non-compliance by any building located on the Merged Zoning Lot with the Zoning Resolution.
